name: FGM Stalzone
storyline: The entire area is filled with strange, anomalous energy, mutated creatures, and mysticism. The zone is guarded by the military, who are ready to shoot anyone who dares to enter. But what lies within the zone? Some see it as a cancerous tumor on the planet, while others see it as a panacea. Regardless of their opinions, everyone will find something unique within the zone.
